name: dataandbeyond--eu-company-verify
description: Check an EU VAT number in VIES and find the company LEI and parent companies in GLEIF, in one call. Also accepts an LEI or a company name. Calls official VIES and GLEIF APIs directly.

queries.title: Companies
queries.description:
VAT numbers (e.g. DK10150817, DE811115368), LEI codes, or company names.
Example values: ["DK24256790","Novo Nordisk"]

items.title: Companies
items.description: VAT numbers (e.g. DK10150817, DE811115368), LEI codes, or company names.

defaultCountry.title: Default country
defaultCountry.description: Two-letter EU code used when a VAT number has no country prefix (e.g. DK).

includeParents.title: Include parent companies
includeParents.description:
Look up direct and ultimate parent in GLEIF (Level 2).
Example values: true

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.

name: dataandbeyond--dk-statistics
description: Search Statistics Denmark (Statbank) tables by keyword, see their variables, and fetch rows as JSON. Official data, CC BY 4.0. Calls api.statbank.dk directly.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description:
search = find tables by keywords; data = fetch rows from one table.
Example values: "search"

search.title: Keywords (search mode)
search.description:
All words must match title/variables.
Example values: "population municipality"

filters.title: Filters (data mode)
filters.description:
Variable code -> list of value codes, '*' for all, '(latest)' for latest period. Omitted variables use totals/latest.
Example values: {"OMRÅDE":["*"]}

lastNPeriods.title: Last N periods
lastNPeriods.description: Overrides time filter with the N most recent periods.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language. If not set: English, and Danish search words are also matched against Danish titles.

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.

name: dataandbeyond--scholar-search
description: Academic papers from Crossref and arXiv (and OpenAlex if OPENALEX_API_KEY is set), ranked by relevance and citations. Calls the official APIs directly.

inputSchema.title: Scholar Search: Crossref + arXiv (+OpenAlex) Papers API

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description:
Free-text topics, titles or keywords.
Example values: ["knowledge graph embedding"]

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max papers per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description:
Deduplicated papers per query.
Example values: 10

sources.title: Sources
sources.description:
Any of: crossref, arxiv, openalex. OpenAlex is used when the Actor has the OPENALEX_API_KEY environment variable set.
Example values: ["crossref","arxiv","openalex"]

items.title: Sources
items.description: Any of: crossref, arxiv, openalex. OpenAlex is used when the Actor has the OPENALEX_API_KEY environment variable set.

fromYear.title: From year
fromYear.description: Only papers published this year or later.

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.

name: dataandbeyond--pubmed-search
description: PubMed search with articles, DOI, PMCID and authors via NCBI E-utilities. Optional NCBI_API_KEY for higher rate limits.

inputSchema.title: PubMed Search API: Articles, DOI, PMCID, MeSH-ready

queries.title: PubMed queries
queries.description:
PubMed syntax, e.g. "crispr[Title] AND 2024[dp]".
Example values: ["semaglutide[tiab] AND 2024[dp]"]

sort.title: Sort
sort.description:
Relevance or newest first.
Example values: "relevance"

ncbiApiKey.title: NCBI API key (optional)
ncbiApiKey.description: Free key raises rate limit to 10 req/s.

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.
